observations: A grey gas cylinder with a red plastic top shroud/handle.
The brand 'CEPSA' and the word 'BUTANO' are printed on the red shroud in photo 0.
The grey body shows visible scuffs, scratches, and dark marks consistent with use.
A brass valve is visible at the top center of the shroud.
A watermark 'GLOBAL SPORTS AND BOOKS' is visible across the image.
Other gas cylinders (orange and blue) are partially visible in the background.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows significant scuffing, scratches, and dirt on the cylinder body.
External wear is visible; the internal state and valve integrity cannot be confirmed from the photo.
Requires verification of valve compatibility with local regulators and confirmation of gas content.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the date stamp, usually found on the metal body, collar, or shroud.
A close-up photo of the valve head to determine if it is a clip-on or screw-on type.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a non-standard adapter or regulator

risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale to show current weight.

proof_requests: Photo of the expiry/manufacturing date stamp.
Close-up photo of the valve opening.
Photo of the weight markings (Tare and Net weight) stamped on the cylinder.
response.reason: The item is a CEPSA gas cylinder. Although the seller claims it is brand new, the photo clearly shows it is used. It can be priced as a used unit at its worst-case state (empty, expired, and requiring a valve adapter).
